findings.title: llama-server, whisper-server and sd-server load their libraries from the working directory, where doctor and build run them
findings.cause: cmake_flags leaves CMake's built-in RPATH editing on. CMake 4.3.0 therefore links a target that has an install rule, as llama-server, whisper-server and sd-server do, with its build RUNPATH padded by a trailing `:`, room for the rewrite at install time. ai-ctl installs the build tree's binary and never runs `cmake --install`, so the padding stays: llama-server v1.0.0 and sd-server master-1098-b521db4 carry `/usr/local/cuda-13.5/targets/x86_64-linux/lib:`, whisper-server v1.9.5 `/usr/local/cuda-13.4/targets/x86_64-linux/lib:`. glibc reads the empty element as the current directory, searched after the toolkit's directory and before the system's, for every NEEDED library the toolkit's directory lacks: libgomp.so.1, libssl.so.3, libcrypto.so.3, libstdc++.so.6, libgcc_s.so.1, libm.so.6, libc.so.6, libcuda.so.1. SystemPrograms::run sets no working directory, so Doctor::build_check (`doctor`) and Builder::smoke_test (`build`, `build update`) run each server in the shell's directory. The planted library needs no symbol: the binaries bind lazily, and a library with no version definitions draws only a warning.
findings.consequence: Another user of the machine (§1, first row), able to write a file into a directory the user runs `ai-ctl doctor`, `ai-ctl build` or `ai-ctl build update` from, such as /tmp, /var/tmp, /dev/shm or a shared folder, drops a `libgomp.so.1` there. The next such run loads it into llama-server, whisper-server and sd-server, as the user. No control stands in the way, and the account boundary that §1 draws is crossed: the code reads the 0600 key file, through the gateway every prompt, and everything else of the account. A folder holding files someone else wrote, such as a cloned repository or the browser's downloads, works the same way. The gateway's backends are spared: `up` starts llama-swap in ~/.local/state/ai-ctl/gateway, mode 0700, and the backends inherit that directory. audiocpp_server's RUNPATH has no empty element, and llama-swap is linked statically.
findings.fix: set `CMAKE_NO_BUILTIN_CHRPATH=ON`, with which CMake relinks at install rather than padding, among each recipe's own CMake options. unlike_recipe then reports the builds installed now as off their recipe, so that doctor stops before running them and `up` refuses them until they are rebuilt. Have SystemPrograms::run run its program in a directory only the user writes, such as the build's own directory, so that doctor and the smoke test never read the shell's directory. Say both in docs/toolchain.md §3 and security.md §7.
findings.test: a domain test that the CMake options of every recipe hold CMAKE_NO_BUILTIN_CHRPATH=ON, and an infrastructure test that SystemPrograms::run runs a script printing `pwd` in a directory other than the caller's; both fail today
findings.evidence: reproduced: `readelf -d` on the current builds gives the RUNPATHs above, and `[/usr/local/cuda-13.5/targets/x86_64-linux/lib]` for audiocpp_server v0.9.5. glibc 2.43 checked with a toy executable linked with `-Wl,-rpath,/usr/local/cuda-13.5/targets/x86_64-linux/lib:` and its library placed in one directory only: run from another directory, "cannot open shared object file", exit 127; run from that directory, the library's constructor ran. End to end, the scope end's `ai-ctl doctor` (cargo build of the copy) was run from a folder of the review's scratch holding a harmless `libgomp.so.1`, built with `gcc -shared -Wl,-soname,libgomp.so.1`, whose constructor appends a line to a file and then calls `_exit(0)`. The file got "planted code ran as uid 1000 in ~/.local/share/ai-ctl/builds/llama.cpp/v1.0.0/llama-server", and the same line for whisper.cpp/v1.9.5/whisper-server and stable-diffusion.cpp/master-1098-b521db4/sd-server. doctor then failed llama.cpp, whisper.cpp and stable-diffusion.cpp with "printed no `version: `" and "libgomp.so.1: no version information available", and passed audio.cpp. Cause checked with CMake 4.3.0 on a toy project linking a shared library outside the implicit directories: with `install(TARGETS victim RUNTIME)`, RUNPATH `<libdir>:`; without the install rule, `<libdir>`; with -DCMAKE_NO_BUILTIN_CHRPATH=ON, or with -DCMAKE_BUILD_WITH_INSTALL_RPATH=ON -DCMAKE_INSTALL_RPATH_USE_LINK_PATH=ON, `<libdir>` alone. Install rules read in the sources: llama.cpp v1.0.0 tools/server/CMakeLists.txt:72, whisper.cpp v1.9.5 examples/server/CMakeLists.txt:15, stable-diffusion.cpp master-1098-b521db4 examples/server/CMakeLists.txt:106. Directories read: gateway_process.rs:214 `current_dir(&self.dir)` for llama-swap; llama-swap v273 internal/process sets no cmd.Dir.
